topic: stop a cat from scratching furniture
core_question: How do I stop my cat from scratching the couch or furniture? (secondary: My laptop says it's plugged in but not charging — how do I fix that?)
answer_summary: Place an appealing scratching post next to the targeted furniture, reward its use, and make the furniture less appealing with double-sided tape or a deterrent spray while trimming claws regularly.; after the topic shift: In Device Manager, uninstall the 'Microsoft ACPI-Compliant Control Method Battery' driver and restart so Windows reinstalls it, fixing the not-charging state.
persona: polite but increasingly frustrated; chatty and verbose
